notes: Timestamps: every block records started and finished with new Date().toISOString() in the page at the start and end of the block script. The browser clock was compared with the backend HTTP Date header at the start and the finish of the run and agreed to the second. This file was written and committed after the run finished.

Navigation between routes used history.pushState with a popstate event unless a block names the control it clicked. Sign-in used the form. Seeding used POST /api/v1/workbench/demo/seed-scenarios with the signed-in staff token, as there is no seed control in the UI.
Injected failures (queue list, Claim detail, section resource, Staff Agent capabilities, filter metadata, stale If-Match) overrode window.fetch in the page and restored it immediately afterwards.

A7 closeReturnsToBubble.focusOnBubble is false because the scripted .click() on the bubble does not move focus to it. A7b focuses the bubble first, as a keyboard or pointer user would, and focus returns to it.
A10 counted one intersection on Activity from a visually hidden (.sr-only) text node. A10b repeats the measurement counting only rendered text: none intersects the bubble.

A11 backPresent false and conversationBack staying on the conversation came from a selector that did not match the button. A11b clicks the Conversations back button and returns to /workbench/conversations.

A11 toQueue: the first compact toggle from AT-04 Overview stayed on the Claim with the queue hidden. The same result occurred once in the earlier run on ae2e65bd. It was not reproduced in 12 later attempts on this head, including two that repeated the viewport switch. A click dispatched in the same tick as the route change reproduces the result against the previous render, which a user cannot do. The cause is not identified; the inventory record lists it as an open question.

A12c and B3: after a collaboration decision and after a Claim decision, focus is on <body> because the control that opened the form or dialog is removed. The inventory record routes this with the Delete-key finding.
A12d: the on-page stale message text was not captured; the 409 response, the kept Decline selection, and the unchanged revision were.
B1: the first seed call returned 401 because the script sent no Authorization header; the second call with the staff token returned 200.
C1b: one injected metadata failure was absorbed by the client retry. C1c fails every metadata request until the error state appears, then restores the network and clicks Retry.
A full page load of /workbench without a trailing slash is answered by the Vite dev server with its base-path notice; in-app navigation is unaffected. All runs entered at /workbench/.
